properties.name: RECORDED UNDER `resync` BECAUSE THE ENUM STILL HAS NO VALUE FOR WHAT THIS IS — the design's knowledge of an unchanged defect improved, which is verbatim what `baseline_established` was created to express and is reserved away from this path. Nothing about the system changed; a second project independently hit the same enum gap. THIS NAME WAS WRITTEN TWICE: the first copy was silently overwritten by the `record_change` call that followed it (see fact:defect-record-change-overwrites-the-name-of-the-event-it-is-filed-under), which is how that defect was found.
